label.en: Worked Example 6.A — Connected Rates of Change

body.en:
A right circular cone of fixed semi-vertical angle has height \( h \) and base radius \( r = \frac{h}{2} \). Water is poured into the cone at a constant rate of \( 12\pi \text{ cm}^3/\text{s} \). Find the rate at which the water level is rising when \( h = 6 \text{ cm} \).

Solution:
Volume of a cone: \( V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi \left(\frac{h}{2}\right)^2 h = \frac{\pi}{12} h^3 \).
Differentiate with respect to \( h \): \( \frac{dV}{dh} = \frac{\pi}{4} h^2 \).
We are given \( \frac{dV}{dt} = 12\pi \text{ cm}^3/\text{s} \). By the chain rule:
\[ \frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{dV}{dh} \cdot \frac{dh}{dt} \implies 12\pi = \left(\frac{\pi}{4} h^2\right) \cdot \frac{dh}{dt} \]
Substitute \( h = 6 \):
\[ 12\pi = \left(\frac{\pi}{4} \cdot 36\right) \cdot \frac{dh}{dt} = 9\pi \cdot \frac{dh}{dt} \implies \frac{dh}{dt} = \frac{12\pi}{9\pi} = \frac{4}{3} \text{ cm/s} \].
Answer: \( \frac{4}{3} \text{ cm/s} \) (or \( 1.33 \text{ cm/s} \)).

label.en: Worked Example B — Instantaneous Rate of Change & Tangent Line
label.ar: مثال محلول B — معدل التغير اللحظي ومعادلة المماس

body.en:
Let \( f(x) = 3x^3 - x^2 + 4 \). Find the instantaneous rate of change \( f'(6) \).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Differentiate term-by-term using the power rule: \( f'(x) = 9x^2 - 2x \).
  2. Substitute \( x = 6 \): \( f'(6) = 9(6)^2 - 2(6) = 324 - 12 = \mathbf{312} \).
body.ar:
لتكن \( f(x) = 3x^3 - x^2 + 4 \). أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي \( f'(6) \).

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. نشتق حداً بحداّ: \( f'(x) = 9x^2 - 2x \).
  2. نعوض \( x = 6 \): \( f'(6) = 9(6)^2 - 2(6) = \mathbf{312} \).

question.en: [Differentiation, Rules & Rates of Change · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Differentiation, Rules & Rates of Change · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).

question.en: [Differentiation, Rules & Rates of Change · Practice 2] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \), evaluate \( g(6) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 32 \).
question.ar: [Differentiation, Rules & Rates of Change · تدريب 2] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \)، فأوجد \( g(6) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 32 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). Setting \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) gives \( 4t = 28 \implies t = \mathbf{7} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). وعندما \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{7} \).
